newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel slips, but helped by distillate APIs.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel slips, but helped by distillate APIs.

text.p: US spot jet fuel prices regained some lost ground late Tuesday after heating oil jumped a half cent in ACCESS trade on bullish distillate inventory data, players said.
New York Harbor 54-grade was offered at about 0.60 cent over the print, a bit firmer than Monday, while Gulf Coast prompt 29th cycle material was stable at about 1.85 cents below the print.
Although distillates grew by 673,000 barrels nationwide during the prior week, heating oil stocks fell 189,000 barrels on the understocked East Coast, the API said.

Domestic output of commercial jet fuel shrank by 131,000 barrels per day, the API said, to 1.37 million barrels. But even so, production was still running about 146,000 barrels per day higher than this time last year.
-- Ransdell Pierson, New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1620
